content.short: Daily PvP token battles — equities, memes, and global crypto. Stake USDG from your arena balance, fight for 24 hours, winners take the losing side's pool.
content.description:
HoodWars is daily PvP token battles on Robinhood Chain. Pick two sides - like NVDA vs AAPL or CASHCAT vs Hoodrat - stake USDG on the team you believe in, and when the timer ends the side with the bigger price move wins the pool.
Global crypto off-chain.
BTC vs SOL, ETH vs XRP - 75+ majors off-chain today, no RH listing required.
Deposit USDG on Exchange. Stakes debit HoodWars ledger - not a wallet transfer per bet.
Chainlink on RH Chain.
NVDA, AMD & stock tokens priced from live oracle feeds on Robinhood Chain.
